name: Enemy and friendly first-hit TTK diagnostics

expectations.scope: Diagnostic fixed-wallet encounter, abilities disabled; enemy virus density deliberately increased to expose multi-hit thresholds.
expectations.measurement: TTK starts at first effective damage, ends only on damage death; spawn-to-damage-death lifetime is separate.
expectations.zero: A zero TTK is a valid first-hit kill at the fixed 60 Hz resolution.
expectations.censoring: Alive and hit-alive organisms are right-censored; leaks, bounds exits, consumption and expiration never become damage-death TTK.
expectations.comparison: Damage ranks can cross a hit-count threshold. Do not assert a numeric universal TTK or substitute missing death observations with zero.
